glyph.isekai_mahou.super_tier.desc: ULTIMATE form (G slot). You stand still while huge blue-white magic circles form in layers for 8 s (rings spinning in opposite directions, a dome of runes, a circle in the sky above the target). It is a SUPREME cast on the Stack: if it is countered, everything shatters and the spell fails. At the end the effects fall from the sky with ×3 power and ×3 area on EVERY enemy within 48 blocks of the aimed point (fire spells become a meteor shower). Uses per day: 1 + Circle/3. An Arcane Hourglass in your inventory makes the cast instant.
glyph.isekai_mahou.fallen_down.desc: A circle lights up on the ground and another in the sky; a colossal pillar of blue-white light descends from the heavens and vaporizes everyone inside (massive armor-piercing damage, Burning). The ground becomes a glass-walled pit (with destruction on) and a heat wave burns and pushes the surroundings. Expand makes the pillar bigger.
glyph.isekai_mahou.black_goat.desc: A black wind swirls around the point hit, pulling enemies into the Black Goat's seal. After 2.5 s every common (non-boss) enemy with up to 40 health (×power) in the area is sacrificed and dies instantly; other enemies take shadow damage, Corruption and Weakness. For every 6 sacrifices (at least 1) a Dark Young is born and fights for you for 60 s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.grasp_heart.desc: A spectral hand tears out the target's heart, which beats faster and faster until it is crushed. Common creatures with up to 60 health (×power) die instantly; others take shadow damage, bleed and are stunned. Bosses and players lose 15% of their max health and are Stunned for 2 s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.death_clock.desc: A giant 12-mark clock appears in the sky above the area and its hand moves one mark per second, with ever deeper bells. When it completes the turn (12 s), every common enemy still in the clock's shadow dies; bosses and players lose 35% of their max health. Fleeing the area saves you. Expand makes the area bigger.
legend.isekai_mahou.goal_of_all_life: The Goal of All Life Is Death
item.isekai_mahou.arcane_hourglass.desc: While it is in your inventory, your next Super-Tier Magic is cast instantly (no 8 s of circles, and it cannot be countered). The hourglass crumbles.
item.isekai_mahou.arcane_hourglass.desc2: Right-click: see how many Super-Tier Magics you have left today.
message.isekai_mahou.legends_e.no_uses: You have used all of today's Super-Tier Magic (%s). It comes back next day.
message.isekai_mahou.legends_e.hourglass: The Arcane Hourglass crumbles: instant cast!
message.isekai_mahou.legends_e.death_clo: ☠ The Death Clock tolls... %s s — get out of its shadow!
announce.isekai_mahou.legends_e.death_cl: THE GOAL OF ALL LIFE IS DEATH
command.isekai_mahou.legends_e.reset: Super-Tier Magic uses reset for %s player(s).
